description: Name the drill type and ask for the first step on a Quant Daily question. Does not reveal the option or the worked explanation. Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person.

attemptId.description: Conversation id returned by get_daily_drill on Quant Daily. Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person. Pass this same id on every later call in the conversation.

drill.description: Which question. "daily" is today's shared drill. A practice id (practice-0, practice-1) is the one get_practice_drill returned.

lang.description: Optional. en only. hi is rejected: Quant Daily is English only.
